1.web: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
1.asv: Doth not wisdom cry, And understanding put forth her voice?

2.web: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
2.asv: On the top of high places by the way, Where the paths meet, she standeth;

3.web: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
3.asv: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, At the coming in at the doors, she crieth aloud:

4.web: “To you men, I call! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
4.asv: Unto you, O men, I call; And my voice is to the sons of men.

5.web: You simple, understand prudence. You fools, be of an understanding heart.
5.asv: O ye simple, understand prudence; And, ye fools, be of an understanding heart.

6.web: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
6.asv: Hear, for I will speak excellent things; And the opening of my lips shall be right things.

7.web: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
7.asv: For my mouth shall utter truth; And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

8.web: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
8.asv: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

9.web: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
9.asv: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.

10.web: Receive my instruction rather than silver; knowledge rather than choice gold.
10.asv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; And knowledge rather than choice gold.

11.web: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
11.asv: For wisdom is better than rubies; And all the things that may be desired are not to be compared unto it.

12.web: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
12.asv: I wisdom have made prudence my dwelling, And find out knowledgeanddiscretion.

13.web: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
13.asv: The fear of Jehovah is to hate evil: Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the perverse mouth, do I hate.

14.web: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
14.asv: Counsel is mine, and sound knowledge: I am understanding; I have might.

15.web: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
15.asv: By me kings reign, And princes decree justice.

16.web: By me princes rule; nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
16.asv: By me princes rule, And nobles, evenall the judges of the earth.

17.web: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
17.asv: I love them that love me; And those that seek me diligently shall find me.

18.web: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
18.asv: Riches and honor are with me; Yea, durable wealth and righteousness.

19.web: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold; my yield than choice silver.
19.asv: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my revenue than choice silver.

20.web: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of justice;
20.asv: I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice;

21.web: That I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
21.asv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance, And that I may fill their treasuries.

22.web: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
22.asv: Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way, Before his works of old.

23.web: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
23.asv: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, Before the earth was.

24.web: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
24.asv: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, When there were no fountains abounding with water.

25.web: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
25.asv: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills was I brought forth;

26.web: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
26.asv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

27.web: When he established the heavens, I was there; when he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
27.asv: When he established the heavens, I was there: When he set a circle upon the face of the deep,

28.web: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
28.asv: When he made firm the skies above, When the fountains of the deep became strong,

29.web: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth;
29.asv: When he gave to the sea its bound, That the waters should not transgress his commandment, When he marked out the foundations of the earth;

30.web: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
30.asv: Then I was by him, asa master workman; And I was dailyhisdelight, Rejoicing always before him,

31.web: Rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
31.asv: Rejoicing in his habitable earth; And my delight was with the sons of men.

32.web: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
32.asv: Now therefore, mysons, hearken unto me; For blessed are they that keep my ways.

33.web: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
33.asv: Hear instruction, and be wise, And refuse it not.

34.web: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
34.asv: Blessed is the man that heareth me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.

35.web: For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.
35.asv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And shall obtain favor of Jehovah.

36.web: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
36.asv: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: All they that hate me love death.
